messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Detected public object: rwd-staging-logs/tmp/debug-archive-2026-03-18.tar.gz appears to have been uploaded with public-read. Heuristic: long base64-looking strings and private-key markers. Please triage.
jena-oncall: ack. i'll take lead. can someone confirm how long it was public?
sam-sre: pulling metadata now. `aws s3api head-object --bucket rwd-staging-logs --key tmp/debug-archive-2026-03-18.tar.gz` -> LastModified 2026-03-18T09:12:40Z, ACL is public-read currently. Access logs show GETs starting 09:13:05Z.
mira-privacy: looping legal immediately. if any customer identifiers or tokens present we need to notify per policy.
alex-platform: quick grep after download indicates snippets matching `-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----` and truncated secrets like `ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}` within debug/trace files. unsure if full secrets.
jena-oncall: containment plan: 1) remove public ACL 2) snapshot object to secure bucket (read-only) 3) rotate any staging service principals that could be present 4) run token-audit across bundle 5) review CI step that created archive and patch. assigning tasks.
infra-team: removing ACL now. `aws s3api put-object-acl --bucket rwd-staging-logs --key tmp/debug-archive-2026-03-18.tar.gz --acl private` -> applied.
sam-sre: copied object to secure-gathering (restricted) for forensics: `aws s3 cp s3://rwd-staging-logs/tmp/debug-archive-2026-03-18.tar.gz s3://secure-gathering/INC-2026-452-debug-archive.tar.gz` 
mira-privacy: confirmed legal-ops joined. legal asked to preserve chain-of-custody and not to share object contents outside the investigation team.
infra-team: who owns the staging runtime identity? looks like svc-ci-staging (svc principal). initiating key rotation and revocation of active access keys. ETA 10m.
alex-platform: starting vault sync and k8s secret refresh. will update pods via rolling restart after new secrets are in.
sam-sre: initial forensic grep: `zgrep -iE "ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----" /tmp/debug/* | head -n 50` -> several matches, most seem truncated; one full-looking SSH private key found inside test/ssh_debug.log (may be ephemeral).
jena-oncall: if there's a full private key, treat as high-risk. infra-team prioritize rotation of any keys matching found patterns and rotate any CI tokens used to upload artifacts.
infra-team: rotated svc-ci-staging keys and disabled previous keys at 2864010200. created new vault secrets and set rotate flag for related CI tokens.
support-ops: checked customer-facing systems for impact: none. staging-only artifact. no open customer tickets referencing staging artifacts.
mira-privacy: legal requests a short incident summary and confirmation whether customer data present. sam, can you run a targeted search for email addresses, customer IDs (CID- prefix), and full SSNs (regex)?
sam-sre: running searches: emails: none; CID- pattern: none; SSN regex: none. only internal run IDs and developer emails (company domain). risk to customers appears low.
incident-bot: runbook triggered: runbook "log-exposure-staging" steps executed: suspend-public, copy-to-secure, rotate-identity, notify-legal. https://redwood.internal/runbooks/log-exposure-staging
jena-oncall: CI fix in progress: adding gate to avoid packaging debug keys, PR #4720 in draft to strip secrets and block artifact ACLs.
alex-platform: rolling restarts done. staging pods healthy. monitoring for auth errors during secret swap.
infra-team: all rotated secrets injected via vault sync at 2864010305. revoked old tokens.
mira-privacy: legal confirmed no regulatory escalation required given no customer PII. they want a retained forensic copy and a timeline in ticket INC-2026-452.
sam-sre: running full token sweep job: `python tools/token_scan.py --bucket rwd-staging-logs --prefix tmp/ --output /tmp/scan-report.json` ETA ~12m. will post report.
support-ops: preparing an internal blurb for CS/Account teams in case customers inquire; marking as internal-only for now.
jena-oncall: incident summary: public debug archive exposed briefly (~<15m), contained, copied to secure bucket, rotated staging/CI secrets, CI guardrail PR, legal notified, monitoring in place. next: postmortem with timeline and follow-ups assigned.
alex-platform: note: add S3 bucket policy to deny public ACLs on `rwd-staging-logs/tmp/*` and add CI check to prevent artifact ACL overrides.
mira-privacy: assigning roles: jenna-oncall (lead), sam-sre (forensics), infra-team (rotation & vault), alex-platform (deploy & CI fix), legal-ops (retention & review), support-ops (customer comms standby). ticket INC-2026-452 created.
jena-oncall: thanks all. i'll keep thread updated with token-scan results and final timeline. :lock:
